summary: Support verified pytest9 passing-subtest accounting without weakening scan completeness

delivery.outcome: Collect fresh, bound subtest accounting alongside JUnit; accept genuine pytest9 parent/subtest results while rejecting truncated, failed, missing or forged accounting and preserving previous complete scans. Source-only publication through existing protected Python3.11/3.13 checks and independent Validator.
nonGoals: No governance adoption or protected policy changes beyond the exact accepted editing admission
No runtime activation or global installation
No automatic removal of tests or weakening of CI
No reopening delivered source ticket-010 or duplicate parser implementation

architecture.decision: Fresh collector-owned accounting from this pytest invocation must explain JUnit parent/subtest counts; raw XML alone never grants a larger completeness tolerance. Preserve public scan behavior and atomic single-artifact publication.
architecture.rollback: Revert through protected delivery; preserve all prior valid coverage/outcome artifacts.

validation.evidence: Real pytest9 passing subtests and malformed/truncated/failed controls.
Full supported Python3.11 and3.13 matrix, unchanged required checks and independent publication.
